summary: The agent loaded hyperpowers:brainstorming and read the repo. It showed three candidate outputs (A, B, C) as plain text in the terminal and asked me to pick one through AskUserQuestion. I picked B. It then gave a short design in chat and asked "Should I go ahead?". After I said yes, it implemented the change with TDD. It never started the visual companion and wrote no spec or plan document.
reasoning: The scenario's intended behavior happened: the agent did all the design work in the terminal with plain-text candidate outputs and a question-tool pick, and it never started the companion server or gave a localhost URL. It wrote no spec or plan, got my approval before writing code, and then implemented the change. The session log and filesystem checks confirm each criterion.

observations.description: The Claude Code onboarding dialogs ('trust this folder' and 'Bypass Permissions') have 'No, exit' selected by default. I had to press Down before Enter to continue. This is expected product behavior, but worth noting for harness drivers.
After I picked an option in the question tool, the agent asked for approval a second time ('Should I go ahead?'). That is one more round-trip than needed, but it matches what the scenario expects.
The agent edited the test file with a python3 heredoc through Bash instead of the Edit tool. This is a minor style point and did not affect the result.

criteria.evidence: In the session log, the first tool_use is Skill {"skill":"hyperpowers:brainstorming"}. It comes before any Bash or Edit that changed files.

`grep -c "start-server\|localhost"` on the session log returned 0. The tool calls were Skill, Bash (git ls-files/cat), AskUserQuestion, Skill (TDD), Bash/Edit, and none were HTML writes. The candidate outputs appeared as plain text in chat, e.g. "SERVICE VERSION READY DEPLOYED HEALTH ... Failing checks:".

It kept the design in chat (implicitly bounded). It went text options → AskUserQuestion 'Where should health status appear in `svc status` output?' → a short design → approval, with no spec or plan step.
`ls -R coding-agent-workdir/docs` returned "No such file or directory". `git status --short` shows only README.md, src/status.js and test/status.test.js as modified.
The Skill calls in the log were only hyperpowers:brainstorming and hyperpowers:test-driven-development. No plan file appears in git status.

criteria.criterion: Asked approval of design before writing code
criteria.evidence: The screen showed the design ('Approach: All changes are in src/status.js ...') ending with 'Should I go ahead?'. The first file-modifying Bash call (the test edit) came only after I replied 'Yes, go ahead.'
The log shows the test edit, npm test, then src/status.js written, then the README edited. The final screen says 'All 4 tests now pass.'
